research_question: Can one characteristic-managed neural factor trained only to complement FF5 plus momentum pass the joint distance, raw-moment and alpha teacher gate?
fixed_base_factors: Ken French five factors plus momentum
external_assets: 49 industry portfolios, never used in the training loss
training_objective: Across four chronological training blocks, minimize mean plus one-half worst-block value of the sum of normalized strict-self-pricing equal-weight Euler loss, normalized strict-self-pricing ridge-HJ loss and normalized factor-regression alpha loss for FF5 plus momentum plus the learned factor. Add concentration regularization only; no hyperparameter sweep.
checkpoint_rule: Maximize the negative analogous two-block validation loss. Fixed 80 epochs, patience 12, learning rate 0.0003 and one seed-independent specification.
development_gate: Against FF5 plus momentum on the combined 74 assets, require nonpositive five-seed mean differences in gamma-zero distance, gamma-one distance, mean absolute Euler moment and mean absolute alpha; at least four of five seeds must jointly improve raw moments and alpha; and 500-draw circular 12-month block-bootstrap upper 95% bounds for both distances and alpha must be nonpositive.
stopping_rule: This is the final G1 teacher family. If it fails, stop teacher architecture search, keep the sealed period closed and position paper one around metric-dependent compressibility and the market-direction mechanism.
